items.name: Button
items.description: Triggers an action with primary, secondary, or destructive emphasis.

items.name: Button group
items.description: Joins related buttons, or a button and its menu, into one row or column.

items.name: Menu
items.description: Opens a list of actions from a trigger.

items.name: Context menu
items.description: Opens actions for an item on right-click, long press, or keyboard.

items.name: Toggle button
items.description: Switches a button between selected and unselected states.

items.name: Toggle button group
items.description: Groups toggle buttons for one or more choices.

items.name: Toolbar
items.description: Groups related controls in one tab stop, with arrow keys to move focus.

items.name: File trigger
items.description: Opens the file picker from a button or other trigger.

items.name: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value to the clipboard and shows the result.

items.name: Command palette
items.description: Opens a search dialog to find and run commands.

items.name: Text field
items.description: Accepts one line of text, with a label and validation.

items.name: Password field
items.description: Accepts a password, with a button to show or hide it.

items.name: Inline edit
items.description: Edits text in place and keeps the draft when the save fails.

items.name: Input group
items.description: Joins an input with a prefix, suffix, or action.

items.name: Text area
items.description: Accepts multiple lines of text.

items.name: Number field
items.description: Accepts a number, with buttons to increase and decrease it.

items.name: Search field
items.description: Accepts a search query, with a button to clear it.

items.name: Select
items.description: Selects one option from a list in a popover.

items.name: Native select
items.description: Selects one option with the native HTML select element.

items.name: Combo box
items.description: Selects one or more options from a list that filters as you type.

items.name: Autocomplete
items.description: Filters a menu or list from a search field as you type.

items.name: Token field
items.description: Turns typed entries into tokens that you can edit and remove.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: Selects or clears one independent option.

items.name: Checkbox group
items.description: Groups checkboxes to select one or more options.

items.name: Radio group
items.description: Selects one option from a short visible list.

items.name: Rating input
items.description: Sets a star rating with radio controls.

items.name: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off immediately.

items.name: Slider
items.description: Selects a value or range on a track between a minimum and maximum.

items.name: Drop zone
items.description: Accepts files that you drag and drop onto it.

items.name: Attachment
items.description: Shows the name, size, preview, and upload state of a file.

items.name: Form
items.description: Groups fields and handles validation and submission.

items.name: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related native form controls under a legend.

items.name: Date field
items.description: Accepts a date, with one editable segment for each part.

items.name: Time field
items.description: Accepts a time, with one editable segment for each part.

items.name: Calendar
items.description: Shows a month grid to select one date.

items.name: Range calendar
items.description: Shows a month grid to select a start and end date.

items.name: Date picker
items.description: Accepts a date that you type or select from a calendar popover.

items.name: Date range picker
items.description: Accepts a date range that you type or select from a calendar popover.

items.name: Color field
items.description: Accepts a hex color, or one color channel as a number.

items.name: Color swatch
items.description: Shows a sample of a color.

items.name: Color swatch picker
items.description: Selects a color from a set of swatches.

items.name: Color picker
items.description: Selects a color with a color area, hue slider, and hex field in a popover.

groups.title: Overlays
groups.description: Panels and messages above the page.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: Shows a focused task in a modal above the page.

items.name: Sheet
items.description: Shows a swipeable panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

items.name: Popover
items.description: Shows content in a panel anchored to its trigger.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: Shows a short hint when you hover over or focus its trigger.

items.name: Toast
items.description: Shows a brief notification after an action.

items.name: Link
items.description: Navigates to another page or location.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Shows one panel of related content at a time.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Shows the path of links to the current page.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Shows links between pages of results.

groups.title: Collections
groups.description: Lists, trees, and tables of items.

items.name: List box
items.description: Selects options from a list that stays visible.

items.name: Grid list
items.description: Shows a list of interactive rows that you can select and act on.

items.name: Tree
items.description: Shows nested items that you can expand, collapse, and select.

items.name: Tag group
items.description: Shows a group of tags that you can select or remove.

items.name: Table
items.description: Shows data in rows and columns, with sorting and resizing.

items.name: Data table
items.description: Shows rows with search, filters, sorting, selection, and pagination.

groups.title: Feedback
groups.description: Messages, status, progress, and loading states.

items.name: Alert
items.description: Shows an inline message about a status or event.

items.name: Badge
items.description: Labels an item with a short status or count.

items.name: Progress bar
items.description: Shows how much of a task is complete in a horizontal bar.

items.name: Progress ring
items.description: Shows how much of a task is complete in a ring.

items.name: Meter
items.description: Shows a measured value within a known range.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: Shows the current step and the steps already complete.

items.name: Spinner
items.description: Shows a loading indicator for a task with no known end time.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: Shows a placeholder shape while content loads.

items.name: Empty state
items.description: Shows why a view is empty and what to do next.

items.name: Card
items.description: Groups related content and actions in one container.

items.name: Accordion
items.description: Shows a set of sections that expand and collapse.

items.name: Disclosure
items.description: Shows or hides one section of content.

items.name: Separator
items.description: Shows a line between sections of content.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: Shows an image or initials for a person.

items.name: Description list
items.description: Shows pairs of terms and details.

items.name: Stat
items.description: Shows a labeled metric with supporting details.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: Shows events in a time-ordered sequence.

items.name: Kbd & code
items.description: Shows keyboard keys and inline code in text.

groups.title: AI
groups.description: Prompts, answers, agent steps, and sources.

items.name: Message
items.description: Shows a message in a conversation.

items.name: Agent status
items.description: Shows the current step of an agent and its state.

items.name: Tool call
items.description: Shows a tool call and its status, and expands to show the input and output.

items.name: Source link
items.description: Links an answer to its source.

items.name: Prompt input
items.description: Accepts a prompt to send, with files and actions.

items.name: Reasoning
items.description: Reveals the thinking of an agent and how long it took.

items.name: Response
items.description: Shows a streaming answer with its status and actions.

items.name: Text swap
items.description: Swaps text with a short fade when its value changes.

items.name: Animated number
items.description: Counts to a new number or slides the digits that change.

items.name: Text reveal
items.description: Reveals text word by word or character by character.

items.name: Text scramble
items.description: Scrambles characters and resolves them into new text when its value changes.

items.name: Presence
items.description: Animates content in when it appears and out before it unmounts.

items.name: Presence list
items.description: Animates list items when you add, remove, or move them.

items.name: Stagger group
items.description: Reveals a group of items one after another when it enters the viewport.

items.name: Layout morph
items.description: Crossfades new content and animates the container to its new size.

items.name: Marquee
items.description: Loops a row of content with a built-in pause control.
